name: Sazlık Ailesi
scene: A graceful duck swims among tall reeds and broad rippling water bands.
notes: Redrawn from story_duck with vitray_fox as the style reference. Target 27–37 panes; approximately 35 substantial enclosed colour components in the selected second generation. Portrait 1086×1448, closed oval rim, white exterior. Reviewed both generations; regenerated once to simplify excessive reeds and feather divisions. Subject/background colour pairs are preserved. Remaining doubts: slight tonal shading persists despite flat-fill instructions; adjacent amber head pieces and some teal background pieces share a colour and may merge when traced. Eye meets a head separator; tight tapered contacts at the neck, wing and right reeds require downstream geometry review. No obvious loose line ends; this design sheet is not a geometry audit or finished glass artwork.
